        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

arguments.title: Historical note — Alex’s informal service responsibilities, May 2, 2023
arguments.body:
On May 2, 2023, Alex’s runbook-audit prep listed two older services as informal responsibilities, separate from the three services he directly owned:

- **legacy-aggregator:** Alex was informally carrying it because the migration away from it was not yet fully complete.
- **metric-rollup:** Alex treated it as a historical service that was effectively unowned in practice.

This records the audit-prep snapshot, not a formal ownership assignment.
